verified against Showdown's tox condition source (onSwitchIn resets effectState.stage to 0): the per-turn multiplier resets back to stage 1 every time the badly-poisoned holder switches out and back in, even though the poisoned status itself is NOT cured by switching — a commonly-assumed-wrong mechanic (people expect the counter to keep climbing forever through switches, but it doesn't)

counter increments once per turn end while badly poisoned, capped at 15 (verified against Showdown source, effectState.stage maxes at 15 and simply stops incrementing — damage stays at 15×7% every turn thereafter, it does not wrap or keep climbing); persists across turns while badly poisoned remains active, but resets to 1 on switch-in per the on_switch_in block above, and only resets to 1 the hard way if the status is cured and Toxic is inflicted again fresh
